rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Type
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Distinct class to which a group of entities or concepts with similar characteristics or attributes belong to.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: File repository
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Structured information on a file repository.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Storage size
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Quantitative value defining how much disk space is used by an object on a computer system.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Name
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Word or phrase that constitutes the distinctive designation of a being or thing.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Format
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Method of digitally organizing and structuring data or information.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Iri
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Stands for Internationalized Resource Identifier which is an internet protocol standard that builds on the URI protocol, extending the set of permitted characters to include Unicode/ISO 10646.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Hosted by
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Reference to an organization that provides facilities and services for something.

rdf:Description.rdfs:label: Hash
rdf:Description.rdfs:comment: Term used for the process of converting any data into a single value. Often also directly refers to the resulting single value.
